title: JMD RRR rambutan: Fruit and Tree Characteristics
metaTitle: JMD RRR rambutan: Fruit and Tree Characteristics
metaDescription: JMD RRR rambutan is a rambutan variety from Jesus M. Dimapilis. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: JMD RRR is a registered rambutan variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2022 as NSIC 2022 Rm 09. Jesus M. Dimapilis bred it. Its record notes a yield of 130kg average.

heroImage.alt: Young fruit trees planted in straight rows on cleared red soil, the kind of farm where JMD RRR rambutan is grown

blocks.text: Compare it with the others in our [rambutan variety finder](/crop-varieties/rambutan), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for fruit trees](/land-preparation/fruit-tree-land-preparation).
Key facts about JMD RRR rambutan
When does it bear, and how much?

A registered tree variety is described from its mother tree, not from trial plots. The mother tree of JMD RRR was about 12 years old and about 7.1 meters tall when it was registered. Its record notes a yield of 130kg average. It bears every year. A grafted or marcotted tree bears years sooner than one grown from seed, and its yield climbs as the tree grows.

anee.io keeps the records of each block of trees, from fertilizer to harvest, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside them.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit rambutan fields most often: [cacao pod borer](/pests/cacao-pod-borer), [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [mealybug](/pests/mealybug). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
A fruit of JMD RRR weighs about 38.18 grams, and its shape is ovoid. The flesh is pearly white and smooth and firm. The edible part is 54.92 percent of the fruit.
Where and when to plant JMD RRR rambutan

Pick a registered selection whose flesh comes off the seed cleanly, which buyers pay more for. Plant budded trees. A registered tree variety is a selection from one proven mother tree, and only grafted, budded or marcotted plants carry its traits. A seedling grown from its seed can turn out quite different. So buy from a nursery accredited by the Bureau of Plant Industry, and ask which mother tree the scions came from. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng puno](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-puno).

items: Buy grafted or budded plants from an accredited nursery, with the variety name on the tag.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Plant a few trees first if the variety is new to your area, before you fill the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Where can I buy planting material of JMD RRR?
items.a: Buy grafted, budded or marcotted trees from a nursery accredited by the Bureau of Plant Industry, so you get the true variety. Ask your provincial agriculture office for the nearest one.
